What is breakaway torque? A 4-pole, 70kW, 3-φ, delta-connected, 60Hz, 440V 10   
cylindrical rotor synchronous motor runs at rated condition with 0.8pf lagging   
The motor efficiency excluding field and stator losses, is 95% and Xs = 2.5Ω   
Calculate:   
(i)Maximum torque produced   
(ii) Armature current   
(iii) Back emf   
(iv) Power angle and   
(v) Mechanical power developed
